_note: The masjids people can find in Settings → Share & follow → Find your masjid. Each code (4-16 letters or digits) has a name and city; with the Google Sheet source (SETTINGS_SOURCE=sheet) also the ID of its own sheet, shared 'Anyone with the link: Viewer'. Self-serve masjids aren't listed here: the deploy adds the approved ones from the registration sheet. "listed": false leaves a masjid out of the list. Keys starting with _ are ignored. See docs/remote-settings.md.
